entities.name: Siege of Hikida Castle
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The 1573 siege of Hikida Castle  was one of many battles the warlord Oda Nobunaga fought against the Azai and Asakura clans during Japan's Sengoku period. These two families were among the staunchest opponents of Nobunaga's attempts to seize land and power for himself.
